_comment: Lead-time / holiday calendar for the par model. COPIED from the lightspeed-reorder skill's rules.json (holidayMondays, holidayShifts) plus the NSW public holidays that fall on a FRIDAY, which that file never needed. The par model must not read anything outside this repo at runtime, so these dates live here.

order._comment: Pars are reviewed and the ILG order is placed Sunday evening; ILG's cutoff is 11:00 Tuesday, so a Sunday order makes the Wednesday run.

delivery._confirmed: ILG confirmed by Zak, Jun 2026 (rules.json holidayShifts.ILG.confirmed=true). Tuesday suppliers (Paramount/Bacchus/Grifter/Lion) probably slip a day too but are UNCONFIRMED and are not modelled here.
rules: Normal week: order Sunday -> delivery Wednesday.
Holiday MONDAY in the delivery week: the Wednesday run slips to FRIDAY.
Holiday on the resulting delivery day (a holiday FRIDAY): NO delivery that week at all; the goods slip to the next available delivery day, which is the following cycle's run.

day_weights._comment: Exposure is counted in weighted DAY-UNITS, not flat weeks. Fri/Sat/Sun trade about double a weekday at Stowaway; a public-holiday Monday trades like a weekend day. A normal Wed->Wed cycle is 1+1+2+2+2+1+1 = 10 day-units, which is the denominator everything else is expressed against.

publicHolidays._comment: NSW public holidays. holidayMondays/holidayShifts came from the reorder skill's rules.json; the Friday and other-day entries were added here because the delivery chain needs them (a holiday FRIDAY kills a slipped delivery outright).

christmas_2026._comment: THE BIG ONE. Read data/_par_review/christmas_2026.md before the December orders.

chain.note: last normal ILG run before the break
Mon 28 Dec is a public holiday -> Wed 30 Dec slips to Fri 1 Jan; Fri 1 Jan is New Year's Day -> NO delivery at all

christmas_2026.action: The order placed ~Sun 20 Dec 2026 must cover 23 Dec -> 6 Jan, over peak summer trade. Expect roughly 2.1x a normal cycle. Confirm supplier shutdowns in late November.

supplierShutdowns._comment: Supplier Christmas/New Year shutdown windows. Suppliers publish these in early-to-mid December; until they land the model falls back to the public-holiday delivery chain above, which is the OPTIMISTIC case (it assumes ILG runs on 6 Jan). Fill these in and the calendar will use them.
